instruction: Look for Play-Doh toys that are appropriate for kids and sort them from lowest to highest price.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Play-Doh toys on Kohls.com, filtering for kids category, and sorting by price from low to high. Evaluator verifies breadcrumbs contain 'Play-Doh', 'Toys', 'Kids' and sort selector shows 'Price Low-High' (S=4 in URL). Uses existing Chrome evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements (Play-Doh search, toys category, kids appropriateness, price low-to-high sorting)

Correct getter logic: get_active_tab_html_parse with category 'class&url' can extract both HTML breadcrumb/filter elements (via class_multiObject_li) and URL parameters (via url_include_expected_multichoice), which correctly captures the navigation state on Kohls.com
Appropriate metric comparison: check_direct_json_object performs exact boolean matching for each requirement (play-doh, toys, kids, price low-high all must be true, is_other_exist must be false)
Semantically correct expected values: All expected values map directly to task requirements and are lowercase to match getter behavior
Correct data flow: Getter extracts breadcrumb text and URL params -> returns JSON with boolean values -> metric compares booleans against expected true/false values
No state freshness issues: Verification reads final navigation state from active tab after task completion, no postconfig needed
